stem: What is the best summary of the events leading up to the author and his daughter chasing crabs?

options.label: F
options.text: After a day in the sun, a girl wants to go to the beach and catch ghost crabs. She has caught ghost crabs before and has grown to be good at it.

options.label: G
options.text: After a day of fishing, a father is relaxing and watching people chase ghost crabs. His daughter asks to go to the beach to catch some crabs, and the father agrees.

options.label: H
options.text: A family is staying in a condominium on the beach at South Padre Island. The father frequently takes his daughter out to chase ghost crabs, and she wants to go again.

options.label: J
options.text: A father who has been fishing in the Gulf of Mexico returns to his condominium, takes a shower, and eats a dinner of fried shrimp. The waves of the ocean make it difficult for him to hear the people on the beach.
